# ligo_holds (Data Source)

The holds that stop a pipeline from creating a binding again: a person removed it in an emergency.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The holds that keep a pipeline from creating a binding again.
data "ligo_holds" "open" {}

data "ligo_holds" "history" {
  all = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `all` (Boolean) Include the holds that were lifted.
- `binding` (String) Only the holds of this binding.
- `limit` (Number) At most this many items (default 1000, at most 10000). More is an error, not a truncation: narrow the filters or raise the limit.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) What was found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `access_level` (String) Its access level.
- `basis` (String) CONTAINMENT or BREAK_GLASS.
- `binding` (String) The binding that a person removed in an emergency.
- `change_request_id` (String) The change request of the removal.
- `deleted_at` (String) When (RFC 3339).
- `deleted_by` (String) Who removed it.
- `id` (String) The hold's id, for ligo hold lift.
- `lift_comment` (String) Why.
- `lifted_at` (String) When.
- `lifted_by` (String) Who lifted the hold, if it was.
- `managed_by` (String) The automation that owned the binding.
- `source` (String) Its source.
- `target` (String) Its target.
